name: PCMTGlossary
title: PCMT Glossary Terms
description: CodeSystem for product attributes and terminology used in the SMART Product Catalogue Management Tool (PCMT). Core domain entities (Generic Product, Trade Item, Regulated Trade Item, Product Master Data) are anchored in the mounted dth-pc glossary (https://litlfred.github.io/dth-pc/v0/ns#glossary/dth-pc/).

concept.definition: Smallest unit of a product that can be administered or dispensed to a patient (handbook Fig 11, p.31).
Smallest unit of a product that can be administered or dispensed to a patient (handbook Fig 11, p.31).
Physical form in which a pharmaceutical product is produced and dispensed, such as tablet, capsule, or injectable solution.
Path by which a health product is taken into the body, such as oral, intravenous, or topical.
Amount of active ingredient per unit of use, such as 500mg per tablet or 10mg/mL.
Length of time a health product may be stored without becoming unfit for use, consumption, or sale.
Conditions required to maintain product quality during storage and transport, such as temperature range or light protection.
